name: firewall
title: The Firewall
description: You have entered a digital firewall protecting the Code World. The system requires logical thinking to grant access. Solve the challenge to earn a letter for the portal password.

name: database
title: The Database
description: This database stores critical information from the Code World. After the crash, the data is disorganized. Restore order to receive a letter needed for the portal password.

name: logic-module
title: The Logic Module
description: The Logic Module tests your ability to reason and make correct decisions. Apply logical rules to complete the task and obtain a letter.

name: encryption
title: The Encryption
description: All communication in the Code World is encrypted. Decode the message, reveal its meaning, and collect a letter for the portal password.

name: bug-room
title: The Bug Room
description: A malfunctioning piece of code is causing instability in the system. Identify the bug and fix it to secure a letter.

name: portal-control
title: Portal Control
description: This control unit monitors access to the portal. Complete the verification process to obtain a letter required to unlock the portal.
